QuestInfo.name: A Letter to the Queen
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Level 68, #b#p1002104##k send a message.
QuestInfo.1: Apparently, #p1201000# succeeded in decoding the letter and it contains some surprising information! Better head over to #b#m140000000##k immediately and talk to #b#p1201000##k about the contents of the letter.
QuestInfo.2: Amazingly, the letter written by the heroes was addressed to the Queen of the time. The actual content of the letter simply asked that the Queen take good care of the Seal Stone of #m130000000#.

0.0: Hey, great news! #p1201000# just finished deciphering the letter and it mentions some crazy things! You should head over to #b#m140000000##k immediately and talk to #b#p1201000##k about the letter!
0.1: I've got nothing on the Black Wings yet, so that must mean they didn't learn anything about the Seal Stone! #bWe'll be a step ahead of them this time#k! Hurry!\r\n\r\n#b(When you accept, you will move to Rien.)#k

no.0: Eh? I know you're busy, but work should always come first. What are you thinking? Come on, you know better than that.

1.0: You heard what Tru told you, right? This letter contains incredible information that goes beyond anyone's expectation. The letter was written by the heroes, meaning you and your friends, and the letter was written to...#bthe Empress#k at the time!

yes.0:
The content of the letter is rather simple. 

'Take care of the Seal Stone in #m130000000#.' 

It looks like the #bSeal Stone is indeed in #m130000000##k.

npc.0: You still haven't gone to #b#m140000000##k yet? Hurry, Aran! #b#p1201000##k is anxiously waiting for you!
